name: Beacon
description: A synthetic service-health workspace with incident chronology, local response actions and a public status-page preview.
tagline: Know what changed. Own what happens next.

notes.layout: Midnight product console, light monitor workspace, ordered check inspector, incident timeline and public status preview
notes.motion: Scenario changes, check selection and chronological response updates
notes.interaction: Inspect synthetic checks, filter services, acknowledge incidents, separate internal and public updates, recover a scenario and export a report
notes.provenance: Five original pages with three fictional scenarios, twenty-four ordered checks and tested local incident-response behavior; no live monitoring or alerts.
